system_prompt_addendum.description:
Optional team-conventions text. Empty after trim → stored as NULL.
Plain Option (not Option<Option>) because create has no "leave
existing" semantic. See #54.

input.description: Fields to update. Omitted fields are preserved.

system_prompt_addendum.description:
Outer None = leave existing untouched; outer Some(inner) =
write inner. Inner Some("") / whitespace-only collapses to
NULL.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. Defaults to 50 and is capped at 500.

since_offset.description: Optional byte offset into events.ndjson. Use a returned next_offset as the next cursor.

pinned.description: True pins the mission; false unpins it.

from.description: Omit for the person at the app; otherwise a mission roster handle.

to.description:
Omit for a crew-wide channel post; set to a slot handle for a
targeted message.

title.description: New mission title. The backend trims and rejects empty values.

project_id.description: Destination project ID. Null or omitted unfiles the mission; its cwd is unchanged.

from.description: Omit for the person at the app; otherwise a mission roster handle.

signal_type.description:
Signal type. Human-originated calls keep the workspace whitelist;
roster handles may emit any known type except person/app-only types.

payload.description:
Free-form JSON object carried with the signal. Annotated so schemars
emits a schema with an explicit `type`; a bare `serde_json::Value`
derives a typeless schema (`{}`), which strict MCP clients reject —
and the rejection drops the entire advertised tool list (#240).

project_id.description: Optional project membership. Its cwd is used when cwd is omitted.

goal_override.description:
The mission's goal. When `None` the mission starts with an empty-goal
event (valid — the human may post a `human_said` signal later instead
of setting a goal up front).

cwd.description:
Working directory exposed to every session as `$MISSION_CWD`.
An explicit value overrides the project's bound cwd.

name.description: Project name. Trimmed and must not be empty.

cwd.description: Absolute path to an existing directory.

force.description: Stop running members before deleting. Defaults to false.

name.description: New project name. Trimmed and must not be empty.

permission_mode.description:
Permission mode the role-edit form's dropdown chose. Mapped
to concrete flags on the row's `args` column at create time
via `router::runtime::apply_permission_mode`. Defaults to
`Auto`. The new-role form defaults to codex, where Auto
maps to `--ask-for-approval on-request --sandbox workspace-write`.
For claude-code, Auto is still plan/model-gated; callers that
default to claude-code should send AcceptEdits explicitly.

PermissionMode.description:
Permission mode the role-edit form's dropdown writes onto the
role row's `args` column. The mode space is per-runtime: each
runtime exposes only the modes it natively supports.

claude-code (4 modes — `--permission-mode <value>`):
- **Default** — no flag. Reads only auto-approve; everything else
  prompts.
- **AcceptEdits** — `--permission-mode acceptEdits`. Auto-accepts
  file edits and common filesystem commands (`mkdir`, `touch`,
  `mv`, `cp`, etc.). Available on every plan.
- **Auto** — `--permission-mode auto`. The "real" auto with a
  server-side classifier blocking irreversible / destructive /
  external actions. Requires Max / Team / Enterprise / API plan
  AND a supported model (Opus 4.7 on Max; Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 /
  Opus 4.7 on Team / Enterprise / API). NOT available on Pro,
  Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry. See
  <https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes#eliminate-prompts-with-auto-mode>.
- **Bypass** — `--permission-mode bypassPermissions`. Skip every
  check. Triggers claude-code's one-time consent dialog the first
  time per user account, which is why it's NOT the recommended
  default.

codex (3 modes — codex doesn't have a separate "accept edits"
middle ground, so AcceptEdits is treated as Default for this
runtime):
- **Default** — no flag. Codex's built-in default approval
  cadence (`untrusted`).
- **Auto** — `--ask-for-approval on-request --sandbox
  workspace-write`. The model decides when to ask the user for
  approval; otherwise auto-runs in the workspace. (Codex's
  `on-failure` value is deprecated per `codex --help` and not
  exposed here.)
- **Bypass** — `--ask-for-approval never --sandbox
  workspace-write`. Never ask.

copilot exposes Default (no flag), Accept edits (`--allow-tool=write`), and Bypass (`--yolo`); Auto has no supported equivalent.

antigravity exposes Default (no flag), Accept edits (`--mode accept-edits`), and Bypass
(`--dangerously-skip-permissions`); Auto has no equivalent.

trae accepts `default` (ask), `plan` (plan-only), and
`bypass_permissions` (never ask). It has no auto-approve middle ground:
- **Default** — no flag; use TRAE CLI's configured default.
- **Auto** / **AcceptEdits** — no flag; no native equivalent.
- **Bypass** — `--permission-mode bypass_permissions`.

input.description: Fields to update. Omitted fields are preserved.

permission_mode.description:
Form's "Permission mode" segmented control. `Some(mode)`
rewrites the runtime's permission flags to the canonical args
for that mode (replacing any prior occurrence so duplicates
can't accumulate). `None` preserves the args as-is — callers
that don't surface the control (CLI patches, programmatic
updates) shouldn't have to reason about it. See
`router::runtime::apply_permission_mode`.

role_id.description: Optional role ID. Omit it for a role-free runtime chat.

runtime.description:
Optional runtime registry name. With a role, this overrides the
role's runtime; without a role, it starts a role-free chat.

model.description: Optional model for the selected role or runtime.

effort.description: Optional reasoning effort for the selected role or runtime.

speed.description: Optional per-chat Codex Speed. Omit or null to inherit.

project_id.description: Optional project membership. Its cwd is used when cwd is omitted.

runtime_override.description:
Optional per-slot engine choice. Omit (or null) for the
"Role default" behavior; otherwise an agent runtime registry name.
Shell is not a valid slot override.

model_override.description:
Optional model pinned to the selected runtime. Blank or omitted
inherits from the role template.

ordered_slot_ids.description: Slot IDs in the desired final order. Must include every slot exactly once.

input.description: Fields to update. Omitted fields are preserved.

runtime_override.description:
Per-slot engine choice. Omit to preserve, pass `null` to clear
(back to the role's own runtime), pass a registry runtime
name to override. Only agent runtimes are accepted; shell is not
a valid slot override.

model_override.description:
Per-slot model. Omit to preserve, pass `null` or blank to
inherit, or pass a model name to override.

effort_override.description:
Per-slot thinking effort. Omit to preserve, pass `null` or
blank to inherit, or pass an effort level to override.

codex_speed_override.description:
Per-slot Codex Speed. Omit to preserve, pass `null` to inherit
the role choice, or pass `standard` / `fast` to override it.
